Our Story

Honest work at a fair price

Texas Roofing and Construction handles roof inspection, installation and repair, storm and wind damage, custom carports, remodeling and home water filtration systems.

Owner Enrique Rivera explains everything in detail and answers every question. Customers also mention the crew traveling out to the job, arriving at 8 AM and finishing the same day.
